body:
Changes
- Use SVDPlusD with the noise model we've been using in actual calibrations
- Use shared mask NaN across samples used to compute the TSVD (`ClimaAnalysis.Vars.propagate_nans`), remove collection time-slices/samples that consist of 99% NaNs (`CalibrationTools.drop_empty_times`, currently only applied to MAC)
- Add zonal average to reduce observation fields, applied by default
- Add plots of residual, prior, error/parameters vs iterations

Blockers: Releases of ClimaCalibrate, ClimaAnalysis
